leadText: Kappei Yamaguchi (Japanese: 山口勝平 Yamaguchi Kappei) is a Japanese voice actor for . His real name is Mitsuo Yamaguchi (Japanese: 山口光雄 Yamaguchi Mitsuo) and he was born May 23, 1965 in , . His main role is providing the voice for (Japanese: トオル Tōru).
